hook.text: Epigenome editing changes how genes behave without altering the DNA sequence itself.

buildup.text: Chemical tags on DNA and its packaging proteins control gene activity. Editing these tags can silence a harmful gene.

discovery.text: Unlike CRISPR cuts, epigenome edits are potentially reversible. If something goes wrong, the change can be undone.

climax.text: Early research silenced cholesterol genes and pain receptors in mice using epigenome editing, with no DNA damage.

punchline.text: Why rewrite the code when you can just flip the switch?

quiz.question: What makes epigenome editing different from standard CRISPR?
options: It changes gene activity without altering the DNA sequence
